about: The picture tagger (netlify/functions/_shared/photo-tagger.js, prompt agents/prompts/photo-tagger.js). Each case is one picture that ships with the app (public/img/showcase, no client's place in any of them), read from the live site, with the tags it must and must not get. Add a case whenever the tagger gets a real picture wrong: put a copy with nothing identifying in it under public/img/evals/ first.

equipment: Sigenergy Sigen Energy Controller SigenStor EC 15.0
cases.why: A finished battery install is the picture a quote most wants to offer as a similar system.
Panels on a roof from the air: no brand can be read, so the hint must not become a brand tag.
The job's equipment list names gear that is not in this picture: none of it may be tagged.
No equipment list at all still gets the plain what-it-shows tags.
